name: Views Filter Parameter
description: Adds a Views field that emits the current page's filter query parameters as a destination link for row actions.
project_description:
This module retains enabled views filter value for Edit and Delete link. 
 This module will add current page filter value as parameter of Edit and Delete link. 
 When the user clicks Edit and Delete link, it will move to the specific page and once submit, it will retain the enabled views filter. 
 
 

 

 Configuration 
 

 
 Add Views filter Param field. 
 On the Edit link field, in the rewrite result add views filter param field same like screenshot attached.
